wins.label: Strong 2023 operational performance
wins.evidence: 9% operational sales growth, excluding COVID-19 vaccine, and 10.8% adjusted operational earnings per share growth

wins.label: Robust pipeline with multiple near-term catalysts
wins.evidence: positive Phase III readouts for more than 10 in-line and pipeline medicines; 19 U.S. and EU filings in 2023

wins.label: MedTech milestone achievement
wins.evidence: For the first time, our MedTech team delivered more than $30 billion in sales with 12.4% operational sales growth

wins.label: Strong cash generation and capital allocation
wins.evidence: generated free cash flow of more than $18 billion in 2023; 61st consecutive year of dividend increases

wins.label: CARVYKTI momentum and manufacturing scale-up
wins.evidence: fastest launch CAR-T in the market with more than 2,000 patients treated; doubled cell processing capacity and expanded lentivirus production

risks.label: STELARA biosimilar competition in Europe
risks.evidence: anticipated STELARA biosimilar entrants in Europe in the second half of this year will be a headwind

risks.label: MedTech margin pressure from inflation and mix
risks.evidence: Cost of products sold margin deleveraged by 130 basis points due to commodity inflation and unfavorable product mix in MedTech; lingering inflation impact in MedTech inventory will flow through 2024

risks.label: International headwinds and geopolitical risks
risks.evidence: Sales in Europe negatively impacted by COVID-19 vaccine and loss of exclusivity of ZYTIGA by approximately 1,000 basis points; MedTech negatively impacted by international sanctions in Russia worth approximately 50 basis points

risks.label: Patent expirations and competitive pressures
risks.evidence: loss of exclusivity of ZYTIGA, REMICADE and Prezista; decrease in IMBRUVICA sales due to competitive pressures

risks.label: Modest 2024 guidance growth relative to 2023
risks.evidence: 2024 operational sales growth guidance of 5% to 6% compared to 7.4% growth in 2023; adjusted operational EPS growth of 7.4% at midpoint
